title: LearnUP Generic Event Envelope
description: Standard CloudEvent-compatible JSON envelope for all Kafka domain events across the LearnUP platform.

id.description: Unique identifier for the event instance. Used for consumer idempotency checks.

source.description: URI or service identifier identifying the context in which the event occurred.

type.description: Describes the type of event related to the originating occurrence.

specversion.description: The version of the CloudEvents specification which the event uses.

datacontenttype.description: Content type of the data value.

time.description: Timestamp when the event occurred in ISO-8601 UTC format.

correlationId.description: Trace correlation identifier linking cross-service workflows.
